findings.title: I18n::Backend::Fallbacks included before translate_accelerator monkey-patch breaks lazy loading of fallback locales
findings.body: `config/initializers/i18n.rb` includes `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` into `I18n::Backend::Simple` (line 9), which overrides `translate` to loop over `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` and call `super(fallback, key, options)`. However, `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` only wraps the top-level `I18n.translate` (line 67) to lazy-load `I18n.config.locale`, and `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any translation performed outside a controller request (e.g. background Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, console, or explicit `I18n.t(key, locale: ...)` calls) will not have called `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`, so fallback locales (including `:en` or `SiteSetting.default_locale`) will not be loaded in `I18n.backend` and translations will raise/return missing-translation errors instead of falling back.

findings.title: Symbol vs String mismatch in `@loaded_locales` causes redundant locale reloading
findings.body: `I18n.ensure_loaded!(locale)` checks `@loaded_locales.include?(locale)` and `load_locale` appends `locale` as passed. `FallbackLocaleList#[]` returns symbols (`[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`, though `locale` itself may be a String or Symbol depending on caller), while `I18n.config.locale` in `translate` is always a Symbol (because `I18n.locale=` converts to `to_sym`). If `ensure_loaded!` is called with a String (or if `FallbackLocaleList[locale]` receives a String `locale`), `@loaded_locales` will contain both `'en'` and `:en`, causing `load_locale` to reload and re-parse all YAML translation files for that locale a second time. `ensure_loaded!` / `load_locale` (and `FallbackLocaleList#[]` on line 17 of `config/initializers/i18n.rb`) should normalize `locale = locale.to_sym`.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache key does not account for changes to `SiteSetting.default_locale`
findings.body: In `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` line 72, cached translations are keyed only by `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`. With `FallbackLocaleList` dynamically reading `SiteSetting.default_locale` on every lookup (`config/initializers/i18n.rb` line 17), a translation for a user locale that falls back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` will be permanently cached under the user's locale in `@cache` even if an admin changes `SiteSetting.default_locale`.
